messages:
alice_support: FYI customer (mika_acme) reports duplicate token charges after a 504 + client retry. Says they retried once and saw two invoice line items. attaching initial notes.
mika_acme: We hit a 504, client retried once automatically. No idempotency header from our SDK by default. We only saw two charges — can you confirm why both requests were billed?
evan_engineer: Can you paste the raw request headers + ingress logs around the 10:12:45 window? suspect gateway replay/forwarding during backend flap.
alice_support: Pasting excerpt from customer logs (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
X-Request-ID: req_abc123
User-Agent: acme-sdk/1.4.0
# no X-Idempotency-Key present
```
linda_ops: Checked ingress proxy for that minute — saw connection reset to model-backend and then a replay attempt:
```
[10:12:45] ingress-gw: accept req req_abc123 from 203.0.113.5
[10:12:45] backend: 502 gateway timeout
[10:12:45] ingress-gw: replaying req req_abc123 -> backend-pool-1 (attempt 2)
[10:12:45] ingress-gw: forwarded req new_internal_id=gw-req-4498
```
evan_engineer: That matches a replay path. Important: our current dedupe uses X-Idempotency-Key when present. If client doesn't send it we treat separate forwards as separate billable requests even if request body identical.
billing_bot: Invoice 2024-10-02: customer mika_acme, invoice #INV-8812
- tokens: 1,240 (generation) => $X
- tokens: 1,240 (generation) => $X  <-- duplicate line created by replay
alice_support: Customer confirms they did not provide idempotency header. They rely on SDK retry logic which doesn't set a key by default.
evan_engineer: Short repro to replicate locally (no idempotency header):
```
# simulate client retry on 504
for i in 1 2; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"x"}' || true
done
```
This will create two billable forwards if the gateway replays during a backend failover.
linda_ops: Filed internal ticket INF-4472 to (1) add a dedupe window for identical payload+request-id, (2) surface a warning in Console when customers hit multiple forwards without idempotency keys. Also adding telemetry to link ingress replay id -> ledger entries.
alice_support: Next steps: (a) ask customer to enable client idempotency header (X-Idempotency-Key) or upgrade SDK, (b) ops to correlate ledger entries with gw internal ids and refund duplicates if confirmed. Will update customer later today :thumbsup:
mika_acme: Thanks — please let me know when refund is done, appreciate the quick look.
__notes: thread follows support channel schema: messages field is a single string with speakers prefixed. Short Slack-style messages, includes logs and code blocks.
